title: Discrete asset pricing under transaction costs and model uncertainty with and without short-sale constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.21873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study discrete-time asset pricing with bid-ask spreads and model uncertainty. The family of probability measures enters the no-arbitrage condition through the union of its supports. In the single-period setting, we establish fundamental theorems of asset pricing with and without short-sale constraints. In the unconstrained market, no arbitrage is equivalent to the existence of a full-support martingale consistent price system. Under short-sale constraints, the martingale condition is replaced by a supermartingale condition. We then extend these results to a finite multi-period tree. The initial information is allowed to be nontrivial, so the initial trading cost and valuation bounds may depend on the initial state, and the corresponding inequalities are formulated conditionally. translated_title: 交易成本与模型不确定性下的离散时间资产定价（含及不含卖空限制）
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有买卖价差和模型不确定性的离散时间资产定价问题。概率测度族通过其支撑的并集进入无套利条件。在单期设定中，我们建立了有卖空限制和无卖空限制情况下的资产定价基本定理。在无限制市场中，无套利等价于存在一个全支撑鞅一致价格系统。在卖空限制下，鞅条件被超鞅条件取代。然后，我们将这些结果扩展到有限多期树状模型。初始信息允许是非平凡的，因此初始交易成本和估值界限可能依赖于初始状态，相应的不等式以条件形式表述。最后，对于定价测度族，我们引入了下和上鲁棒超鞅一致价格系统。我们证明无套利意味着这些系统的存在性。
tldr: 本文在离散时间框架下，结合买卖价差和模型不确定性，建立了有/无卖空限制下的资产定价基本定理，并引入鲁棒超鞅一致价格系统以推广多期情形。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes fundamental theorems of asset pricing under transaction costs and model uncertainty in discrete time, with and without short-sale constraints, and introduces robust supermartingale consistent price systems for multi-period extensions.
